description: Write social post drafts for review from a topic and research. Text only: it never posts. 2 credits (EUR 0.02) per successful call; needs a bearer token.

bannedClaims.description: Claims that must never appear — enforced in-prompt AND post-generation.

context.description: Optional research to ground the drafts (e.g. the Markdown from fetch_web_markdown).

count.description: How many drafts to produce (default 3, max 5).

facts.description: The ONLY approved product/business claims (from the Brand Profile).

platform.description: The platform the drafts should be written for (default general).

tone.description: Voice of the drafts, free-form (e.g. "direct, warm, no buzzwords").

name: draft_social_content
